cases.name: CHK-001-h0: batch_add generates uuid _id
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.fixture_batch_add({fixturePath:"_test_uuid",cases:[{name:"t1",run_type:"cli",fn:"story_get",file:"mcp/handlers/story",execute:"return true"}]}); const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"_test_uuid"}); const c = f.cases[0]; const hasUuid = c._id && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(c._id); return hasUuid ? "uuid_ok" : "no_uuid: " + JSON.stringify(c._id)

cases.name: CHK-001-e0: batch add multiple cases unique ids
cases.execute: $handlers.fixture_batch_add({fixturePath:"_test_uuid3",cases:[{name:"a",run_type:"cli",fn:"story_get",file:"mcp/handlers/story",execute:"return 1"},{name:"b",run_type:"cli",fn:"story_get",file:"mcp/handlers/story",execute:"return 2"},{name:"c",run_type:"cli",fn:"story_get",file:"mcp/handlers/story",execute:"return 3"}]}); const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"_test_uuid3"}); const ids = f.cases.map(c=>c._id); const unique = new Set(ids).size === ids.length; return unique ? "all_unique" : "duplicates"

cases.name: CHK-001-e1: old case without _id runs fine
CHK-001-a1: 100 cases all unique ids
cases.execute: const cases = []; for(let i=0;i<100;i++) cases.push({name:"c"+i,run_type:"cli",fn:"story_get",file:"mcp/handlers/story",execute:"return "+i}); $handlers.fixture_batch_add({fixturePath:"_test_uuid5",cases}); const f = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"_test_uuid5"}); const ids = f.cases.map(c=>c._id); return new Set(ids).size === 100 ? "100_unique" : "has_dupes"
